title: bug: the browser's preview Approve button sends the goal's aggregate id where the daemon expects the preview receipt id
description:
Filed 2026-09-09 by architect-ed42e60a from an external review (finding 4, sub-claim B), VERIFIED at HEAD fee4e168 (preview-port.ts has no commits since 51c4a004). This is the control-room half only — NO authority change. The other half (paired browser HUMAN excluded from preview.decide / goal.close by OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_KINDS) is a deliberate policy pin under operator ruling comment-18dc557c and the epic rail on Gate kinds; under the owner's 2026-09-09 direction ("one approval at plan time, then unattended") the machine closes those gates by default, so widening that fence is NOT filed here — if a human needs to intervene from the browser it is a separate ruling.

MECHANISM: apps/control-room/src/v2/approvals/preview-port.ts:51-54 `previewRefOf` builds the payload's previewRef from the affordance's targetAggregateId (the goal), while the daemon's preview.decide edge resolves previewRef as the preview RECEIPT id; the mismatch answers 422 PREVIEW_GOAL_NOT_LANDED @ GOAL_AUTHORITY. The walls are STACKED: the operator-principal fence (403) masks this one for a paired browser user, so "fixing permission alone will not fix that button" — measured true. The receipt id is ALREADY in the browser: needs-you-preview.ts:109 populates facts.receiptId from /preview/read; live-needs-you.tsx:187 does not pass it. preview-port.test.ts:19/:60 use a fixture where targetAggregateId and the asserted previewRef are the SAME string, which is why the defect is green today — that identity is the mutation that reddens the port. preview-approve-live.spec.ts:136-141 has a WALL B arm that currently asserts "refuses".

FIX SHAPE: make PreviewPort.submit take the receipt id explicitly (submit(affordance, receiptId, decision, findings)), build the payload with previewRef: receiptId, pass facts.receiptId from live-needs-you.tsx:187; harden preview-port.test.ts so the fixture's targetAggregateId and the asserted previewRef are DISTINCT strings (e.g. `preview:goal-7` vs a 64-hex id); flip the WALL B arm in preview-approve-live.spec.ts:136-141 from "refuses" to "commits" — that spec decides as the configured OPERATOR by design, so it exercises this fix without touching the fence.

No open board row owns this (task-4cbaca29, DONE, disclosed both walls as follow-up; task-6cbcf5ff, DONE, recorded it as "ALREADY KNOWN … COVERED BY A COMMITTED ARM" — the arm covers the refusal, not the fix). A malformed copy of this row (task-a936f924, empty description) was deleted minutes before this one was filed.
